in_greek.name: Αγνη
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'agnos', meaning pure, undefiled. In the Bible, the name Agnes is derived from this Greek name.

in_latin.name: Agnes
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'agnus', meaning lamb, and the suffix '-es', meaning belonging to. The name Agnes is derived from this Latin word, meaning a pure and holy lamb of God.
